capabilities: Chat with an AI that reads and edits notes, files, properties, links and Canvas cards via 22 built-in tools
Attach images, PDFs and Office documents or send a text selection as chat context
Teach vault conventions with AGENTS.md files and reusable Skills invoked with /name
Review, jump to and undo an answer's vault changes from recorded snapshots
Track token use and cost, and compact long conversations; talk via voice with a ChatGPT account
extras: Remote MCP is only available with Anthropic/OpenAI API keys, not the ChatGPT account connection; only public HTTPS MCP servers are supported. Undo is session-bound and unavailable after restart. Vault chat files do not sync by themselves. A detailed user guide is linked separately; installation previously via BRAT is covered with migration steps.

problem: Obsidian has no built-in conversational agent that can act on vault content, so users must leave the app and manually apply AI suggestions to their notes.
